title: DeltaNet low-rank writable state View
hypothesis: When an associative value stream lies in a shared rank-r output subspace, a compact low-rank writable DeltaNet state will preserve sequence recall while reducing serialized state bytes and write cost versus a full matrix state.
mirror_coordinate: Low-rank state coordinate C over a shared output basis U

development.selection_metric: stored-key retrieval nRMSE, actual state payload bytes, update/query MACs

paid_objects: full writable matrix or shared output basis and low-rank state

success_gate: Fresh retrieval nRMSE <=1e-6, at least 25% fewer actual bytes than full matrix, and no more update MACs than full delta rule. Mirror-specific benefit requires beating native low-rank state in bytes/quality/compute.
failure_gate: Quality/reset gate missed, <25% bytes saved, or native low-rank matches Mirror within 1% with equal/better bytes and compute.
boundaries: Synthetic associative sequence only; no trained DeltaNet or language model claim.
Shared value basis is generated and serialized; no free reconstruction state.
Fresh seeds 41 and 67 are not used for tuning.
